name: True Names
description: Patrol tokens name their archmage in full at sight.

name: Veil
description: The party is imperceptible to patrols for its next 5 steps. Routes continue; interception simply fails.

name: Parley Compulsion
description: Once per expedition: the next intercepting patrol's ambush becomes a negotiation instead.

name: Beguile
description: The next negotiation this expedition starts one tension band more favorable.
